microtheory.name: transportation
microtheory.definition: Transportation — movement of people + goods. Modes (road, rail, water, air, pipeline, space), networks, logistics, traffic theory, urban transit, supply chains. From wheel to autonomous vehicles. Substrate analogue: the discipline of moving matter + information through space efficiently.

concepts.name: transportation_definition
concepts.definition: Movement of people, goods, information through space. Modes + networks + operations + costs.

concepts.name: mode_of_transport
concepts.definition: Means of conveyance. Road, rail, water, air, pipeline, conveyor, space. Each with cost + speed + capacity profile.

concepts.name: intermodal_transport
concepts.definition: Combining modes (truck + rail + ship). Containerization revolutionised. Substrate analogue: substrate's heterogeneous communication.

concepts.name: road_transport
concepts.definition: Vehicles on roads. Dominant for short + medium distances. Personal + commercial.

concepts.name: rail_transport
concepts.definition: Trains on tracks. High efficiency long distance + bulk. Steel-on-steel low friction.

concepts.name: maritime_shipping
concepts.definition: Ships on water. ~80% of global trade by volume. Container ships, bulk carriers, tankers.

concepts.name: aviation
concepts.definition: Powered flight. Fastest long-distance passenger transport. Commercial since 1920s.

concepts.name: pipeline_transport
concepts.definition: Fluid transport (oil, gas, water). Highest efficiency for continuous flow.

concepts.name: automobile
concepts.definition: Self-propelled road vehicle. Internal combustion (Otto, Diesel) + electric. Mass production (Ford). Reshaped 20th c.

concepts.name: internal_combustion_engine
concepts.definition: Otto cycle (gasoline) + Diesel cycle. Energy from fuel combustion in cylinder. Foundation of modern transport.

concepts.name: electric_vehicle
concepts.definition: Battery + motor. Higher efficiency, no tailpipe emissions, charging infrastructure required. Surging since 2010s.

concepts.name: autonomous_vehicle
concepts.definition: Self-driving. SAE levels 0-5. Cameras + LIDAR + ML. Long horizon, deployed in limited domains.

concepts.name: ship_marine
concepts.definition: Watercraft. Container ships, tankers, bulk carriers, RoRo. Massive scale economics.

concepts.name: aircraft
concepts.definition: Powered flight vehicle. Fixed-wing (lift from forward motion + airfoil) + rotary (helicopter).

concepts.name: logistics
concepts.definition: Movement + storage of goods. Supply chain management. Just-in-time vs strategic stockpile.

concepts.name: containerization
concepts.definition: McLean 1956. Standardised TEU containers. Reduced shipping costs ~90%. Enabled globalisation.

concepts.name: supply_chain_global
concepts.definition: Networks moving goods across distance. Optimisation + resilience tradeoffs. Disrupted by COVID 2020.

concepts.name: last_mile_delivery
concepts.definition: Final segment of delivery. Often most expensive portion. Urban density + congestion challenges.

concepts.name: traffic_flow_theory
concepts.definition: Mathematical models of vehicle flow. Greenshields, LWR, microscopic + macroscopic. Phase transitions to congestion.

concepts.name: braess_paradox
concepts.definition: Adding road can increase total travel time. Selfish routing diverges from social optimum. Substrate analogue: substrate's selfish-vs-cooperative dynamics.

concepts.name: traveling_salesman_problem
concepts.definition: TSP. Shortest tour visiting cities once. NP-hard. Foundational combinatorial optimisation.

concepts.name: vehicle_routing_problem
concepts.definition: VRP. Optimise delivery routes for fleet. Hugely studied.

concepts.name: queueing_theory_transport
concepts.definition: Erlang. Wait times + capacity. Traffic signals, runway scheduling.

concepts.name: urban_transit
concepts.definition: Bus, subway, light rail, BRT. Mass transit reduces per-capita energy + space. Walkable + transit-oriented development.

concepts.name: transit_oriented_development
concepts.definition: TOD. Dense mixed-use around transit stations. Counters sprawl.

concepts.name: induced_demand
concepts.definition: Adding road capacity attracts new trips, returning congestion. Brilliant traffic-engineer paradox.

concepts.name: transport_externality
concepts.definition: Costs/benefits beyond direct user. Congestion, pollution, noise, accidents. Pigouvian taxes correct.

concepts.name: modal_shift
concepts.definition: Moving travel from one mode to another. Policy lever for emissions + congestion.

concepts.name: supply_chain_resilience
concepts.definition: Ability to maintain function under disruption. Tradeoff with efficiency. Lean fragile; redundancy resilient.

concepts.name: global_value_chain
concepts.definition: Production fragmented across countries based on comparative advantage. Vulnerable to disruption.

rules.name: containerization_revolutionised_logistics
rules.head: Jabberwock examines modern shipping
rules.body: standardised container (TEU) cut loading time + cost ~90%. Enabled current globalised supply chains. McLean 1956. Substrate's standardisation-as-leverage.

rules.name: induced_demand_defeats_pure_road_expansion
rules.head: Jabberwock considers solving traffic congestion
rules.body: adding lanes attracts new trips. Net congestion soon returns. Demand management + pricing required.

rules.name: braess_paradox_warns_against_naive_optimisation
rules.head: Jabberwock adds capacity to network
rules.body: selfish-routing equilibrium can degrade with more capacity. Counterintuitive. Holds in transport + communication networks.

rules.name: supply_chain_resilience_efficiency_tradeoff
rules.head: Jabberwock optimises supply chain
rules.body: JIT lean optimises cost but fragile to disruption. Buffers + diversification trade efficiency for resilience. COVID lesson 2020.

rules.name: externalities_distort_modal_choice
rules.head: Jabberwock evaluates transport mode
rules.body: private cost ≠ social cost when externalities (pollution, congestion, accidents) uninternalised. Pigovian pricing aligns.
